title: Understanding the Objective Function
text: The objective function is a way to measure how well your model is predicting the profits. It involves parameters $$\theta_0$$ and $$\theta_1$$, which you will adjust to minimize the function's value. Think about how each term in the function might affect the outcome.

title: Initial Values and Learning Rate
text: You start with initial values $$\theta_0=1$$ and $$\theta_1=2$$. The learning rate, alpha, is $$0.5$$. These values will guide how much you adjust $$\theta_0$$ and $$\theta_1$$ in each step. Consider how the learning rate affects the size of your steps.

title: Gradient Descent Step
text: In gradient descent, you update $$\theta_0$$ by subtracting the product of the learning rate and the derivative of the objective function with respect to $$\theta_0$$. Try to find this derivative and see how it influences the update.
